text.card: A red giant 6,348 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.86 solar masses and 11.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,985 K at its surface.
